description: The Beibu Gulf offshore-energy team publishes ten years of hourly weather and normalised wind and PV yield for sixteen offshore grid locations in China. GitHub documents 32 UTF-8 CSV files covering 2016–2025, split equally between meteorological inputs and derived generation. Variables include wind speed and direction, irradiance, temperature and per-unit generation, with shared site and UTC time fields. Public access is free; the Data article states CC BY 4.0 although GitHub has no licence file. The regional series can support capacity-sizing and hybrid-generation simulations. Power yields are modelled, not measured, and cleaned satellite-derived weather carries uncertainty. No directly related catalogue resource was identified.
name: Beibu Gulf offshore weather and normalized wind-solar power
